[RULES] <Domain> rulebook. Label each entity in the text with one of the types below.
G1 Label all entities in the text, not only the first one.
G2 Keep each span as short as the entity itself ("a flight to Oslo" -> "Oslo").
G3 When two types fit, the precedence rules below decide.
[PRECEDENCE]
P1 <A cue in the text> decides between TYPE_A and TYPE_B: after "<cue>" or "<cue>" it is TYPE_A; after "<cue>" or "<cue>" it is TYPE_B.
P2 <A visible format, such as a prefix> decides the type, whatever the text calls it: "<prefix>..." is TYPE_C, even when called <other name>.
[TYPE] TYPE_A
[DESCRIPTION] One line saying what this type is.
TA1 "<a short made-up text>" -> "<the span>".
TA2 "<a made-up text where TYPE_B looks right>" -> "<the span>" is TYPE_A.
[TYPE] TYPE_B
[DESCRIPTION] One line saying what this type is.
TB1 "<a short made-up text>" -> "<the span>".
[TYPE] TYPE_C
[DESCRIPTION] One line saying what this type is.
TC1 "<a short made-up text>" -> "<the span>".
[NOT_AN_ENTITY]
NE1 <What is never labelled, even though it looks like one of the types> ("<example>", "<example>").
